# Haulystic

Haulystic is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Haulystic is a company that redefining global e-commerce logistics by simplifying trade, driving growth, and empowering businesses with technology-led solutions. Haulystic employs 11 people, founded in 2016. Headquartered in United Kingdom, with an office in London. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom and Australia.

## About

Haulystic is a pioneer in global e-commerce logistics, leveraging cutting-edge technology and operational expertise to simplify cross-border trade. We offer a comprehensive suite of services, including customs clearance, cross-border logistics, and digital solutions, designed to streamline operations and enhance the customer journey from pre-click to post-click.

Our advanced AI-powered platforms provide 360° visibility, real-time tracking, and intelligent routing, ensuring seamless and efficient global delivery. With a focus on sustainability, we integrate eco-conscious practices and green logistics solutions into every aspect of our operations.

From fast customs clearance to scalable global delivery, Haulystic empowers businesses to thrive in the digital economy. Join us in building a seamless, customer-centric, and sustainable global logistics ecosystem.

# Haulistic

Haulistic is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Haulistic LLC offers 3PL services specializing in multi-modal services backed by proprietary technology & industry experts. Haulistic employs 114 people (+8.6% YoY, +9 people), founded in 2021. Headquartered in Warrenville, Illinois, United States, with an office in Naperville. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Mexico, Philippines, and Canada.

## About

Haulistic’s mission is to be the number one preferred third-party logistics (3PL) company for transporting commercial freight anywhere in the world. We value strong customer relationships built on trust and reliability, taking ownership of our work, and delivering results that exceed expectations.

By anticipating challenges, communicating openly with our customers, and utilizing our TMS, SilverExpress, we can make your shipping destinations feel closer than ever before.

Haulistic has unmatched experience moving large quantities of time-sensitive freight and is a subsidiary of Mullen Group, one of Canada’s largest Logistics providers. Our competitive advantage is our proprietary technology which allows us to seamlessly move Truckload, LTL, Expedite, and International shipments. By leveraging our combined freight spend, we offer customers significant cost savings and provide access to our long list of partner carriers through our free TMS, SilverExpress.

Haulistic provides customers with a dedicated operations team that manages the movement of our customer’s freight from origin to destination on time, and within budget. We have a large domestic and international shipment volume that is a distinct advantage in negotiating carrier rates and brokering freight. Our brokerage department services clients with integrity and treats their shipments with as much respect as we do our own. Our customers appreciate our ability to quickly find capacity, provide visibility, and effectively communicate every shipment from quote to final delivery.
